name: Witch & Warlock
source:
A wizard receives a cute pupil.
But there is a problem.
To share the magical power, they need to have sex.
However, once the magic power is given to the pupil, the master's power will be lost forever.
What kind of future awaits them?

[Edited frrom [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054301.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一名魔法师收下了一个可爱的徒弟。
可是，两人面临着一个难题。
为了分享魔力，他们必须发生性关系。
然而，一旦将魔力传给徒弟，师父就会永远失去这份力量。
等待着两人的，究竟会是怎样的未来？
